Indexes:
    "PK__authors__XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX" PRIMARY KEY, clustered (author_id) CLUSTER
Referenced by:
    TABLE "books" CONSTRAINT "FK__books__author_id__XXXXXXXX" FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id)

Indexes:
    "PK__books__XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX" PRIMARY KEY, clustered (book_id) CLUSTER
Foreign-key constraints:
    "FK__books__author_id__XXXXXXXX" FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id)
